Job Summary

This position is under the directorate of Safety, Health, and Environment and responsible for managing environmental compliance, sustainability initiatives, and environmental protection efforts within an organization. The Environment Officer plays a key role in promoting sustainable practices, managing environmental risks, and supporting the company’s overall environmental goals.The position also involves educating staff, monitoring environmental performance, and reporting on the company’s sustainability and environmental efforts.

Job Responsibilities

Ensure the organization complies with all environmental regulations, laws, and standards at local, national, and international levels

Successfully executed Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Oversight

Drive the development of environmental management plans and sustainability strategies aligned with the company’s broader business goals.

Managing Sustainability & Environmental Performance

Identify, assess, and manage environmental risks (e.g., pollution, resource depletion, waste management), ensuring the implementation of risk control measures.

Managing environmental risks for the long term of the company

Track and report on environmental targets, providing updates on progress toward sustainability goals and recommending actions for continuous improvement.

Monitoring, reporting, and documentation about Environment

Take an active role as role model to provide guide in upholding ethics and integrity (e.g., willing to provide guidance/consultation on ethics and integrity whenever required, continuously uphold ethical values in doing day-to-day process, etc.) in supporting company’s ethical culture.

Zero tolerance to fraud (including bribery)

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome

• SHE risks well maintained
• Target Zero LTI
• SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP, standards and requirements.

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Environmental Engineering or related field

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min 3-5 years’ experience in environmental management, sustainability, or compliance, preferably within an industrial, manufacturing, or corporate environment.
• Strong understanding of sustainability principles, environmental risk management, and best practices in waste management, energy conservation, and resource efficiency.
• Results-driven with a commitment to continuous improvement and environmental sustainability.
• Familiarity with mining and HSE.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skill
• Excellent communication, presentation, and report writing skill
• Fluent in English (written and verbal)
• Attention to detail

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Mechanical Project Staff

Job Responsibilities

• Apply basic flow diagrams as the fundamental basis for engineering design and development.
• Conduct technical analysis and problem-solving to address design-related issues and challenges arising during project implementation.
• Supervise project execution to ensure that activities are completed in accordance with the established schedule, budget, and technical specifications.
• Perform Quality Control (QC) to ensure the quality and compliance of project processes and deliverables.
• Act as a safety officer to ensure the implementation of Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards throughout project execution.
• Supervise and support the erection, installation, and commissioning of equipment and project structures.
• Prepare Engineer's Estimates and Owner's Estimates as a basis for project cost planning and budgeting.
• Create and develop technical drawings using AutoCAD 2D.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful execution and completion of projects.
• Support the development of mechanical systems, steel structures, and water and wastewater treatment systems in accordance with operational requirements.
• Collaborate with farm operations teams to ensure that the design, installation, and maintenance of farm support facilities are carried out effectively and efficiently.
• Provide technical support for farm infrastructure development, including utility systems, poultry housing, water treatment systems, and other supporting facilities.
• Integrate farm operational requirements into engineering project planning and execution.

Job Qualifications

• Minimum Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant field.
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; prior experience in engineering or project-related roles is an advantage.
• Experience in the management of GP, PS, and hatchery facilities, as well as in designing poultry houses and hatchery facilities, is an advantage.
• Possess a basic understanding of Mechanical Engineering, Steel Structure Engineering, and Water and Wastewater Engineering.
• Understand plumbing systems, poultry house ventilation systems, and poultry house feeding systems.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, process flow diagrams, and technical specifications.
• Proficient in using AutoCAD 2D to create and develop technical drawings.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office for data processing, report preparation, and project documentation.
• Ability to prepare project time schedules and process, present, and analyze data to support project planning and control.
• Understand the principles of Quality Control (QC), Occupational Health and Safety (OHS), and project management.
• Possess strong technical analysis, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams, as well as perform effectively under pressure.
• Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken, at a passive or active proficiency level.
• Willingness to work at heights as required for project execution and supervision, while complying with applicable Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) procedures.
• Willingness to travel for business, supervise on-site project activities, and accept assignments throughout Indonesia as required by the company.
• Demonstrate integrity, honesty, discipline, accountability, loyalty, and good communication skills.
• Knowledge of farm operations and Farm Management is an advantage.
• Understand the infrastructure, utilities, and support systems required in the livestock or agribusiness industry.
• Ability to integrate engineering considerations with farm operational requirements to improve operational efficiency

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Mechanical Project Staff​

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Menerapkan flow diagram dasar sebagai konsep utama dalam perancangan dan pengembangan desain teknik.
• Melakukan analisis teknis dan problem solving terhadap permasalahan desain maupun implementasi proyek.
• Melaksanakan supervisi proyek untuk memastikan pekerjaan berjalan sesuai jadwal, anggaran, dan spesifikasi teknis.
• Melakukan Quality Control (QC) terhadap proses dan hasil pekerjaan proyek.
• Bertindak sebagai petugas keselamatan (safety man) untuk memastikan penerapan standar K3 selama pelaksanaan proyek.
• Mengawasi dan mendukung proses erection, instalasi, dan commissioning peralatan maupun struktur proyek.
• Menyusun engineer estimate dan owner estimate sebagai dasar perencanaan biaya proyek.
• Membuat dan mengembangkan gambar teknik menggunakan AutoCAD 2D.
• Berkoordinasi dengan tim lintas fungsi untuk memastikan keberhasilan pelaksanaan proyek.
• Mendukung pengembangan sistem mekanikal, struktur baja, serta pengolahan air dan limbah sesuai kebutuhan operasional perusahaan.
• Berkolaborasi dengan tim operasional farm untuk memastikan desain, instalasi, dan pemeliharaan fasilitas pendukung peternakan berjalan secara efektif dan efisien.
• Memberikan dukungan teknis terhadap pengembangan infrastruktur farm, termasuk sistem utilitas, kandang, pengolahan air, dan fasilitas penunjang lainnya.
• Mengintegrasikan aspek operasional farm dalam perencanaan dan pelaksanaan proyek engineering.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Sipil, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang lain yang relevan.
• Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar; pengalaman kerja di bidang engineering atau project menjadi nilai tambah.
• Pengalaman dalam manajemen kandang GP, PS, dan Hatchery serta pengalaman mendesain fasilitas kandang dan hatchery menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memahami dasar-dasar Mechanical Engineering, Steel Structure Engineering, serta Water & Waste Water Engineering.
• Memahami sistem plumbing, ventilasi kandang, dan feeding system pada fasilitas peternakan.
• Memiliki kemampuan membaca dan menginterpretasikan gambar teknik, flow diagram proses, serta spesifikasi teknis.
• Menguasai AutoCAD 2D untuk pembuatan dan pengembangan gambar teknik.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office untuk pengolahan data, penyusunan laporan, dan dokumentasi proyek.
• Mampu menyusun project time schedule serta melakukan pengolahan, penyajian, dan analisis data untuk mendukung perencanaan dan pengendalian proyek.
• Memahami prinsip Quality Control (QC), keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3), serta manajemen proyek.
• Memiliki kemampuan analisis teknis, problem solving, dan pengambilan keputusan yang baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim lintas fungsi serta mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.
• Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Inggris, baik secara pasif maupun aktif.
• Bersedia bekerja di ketinggian (working at height) sesuai kebutuhan pelaksanaan dan supervisi proyek dengan tetap mematuhi prosedur keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3) yang berlaku.
• Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas, supervisi proyek lapangan, dan penugasan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan.
• Memiliki integritas, kejujuran, disiplin, tanggung jawab, loyalitas, dan kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.
• Memiliki pemahaman mengenai operasional dan manajemen farm (Farm Management) menjadi nilai tambah.
• Memahami kebutuhan infrastruktur, utilitas, dan sistem pendukung pada industri peternakan atau agribisnis.
• Memiliki kemampuan mengintegrasikan aspek engineering dengan kebutuhan operasional serta efisiensi pengelolaan farm.
